generation.mode: built-in ImageGen whole-canvas generation conditioned on a measured layout guide and a canon style crop

lightingIsotropy.metric: 36-bin land-luminance-gradient magnitude peak divided by uniform-bin mean on the delivered source; final water-mask pixels excluded and gradients below 12 luminance units excluded
lightingIsotropy.visualCheck: No cast-shadow field, sun, or time-of-day gradient was observed. Local form shading and ambient occlusion remain; visual flat-value judgment is not claimed as owner acceptance.

buildableVsSteepFraction.basis: manual estimated fraction of non-water land area at native source resolution
buildableVsSteepFraction.method: Broad coherent bench tops and the level knoll count as buildable; exposed terrace faces count as steep; talus, dense gully vegetation, broken margins, and scattered boulders make up the remainder.

crown.method: Median native-pixel outer-foliage width across 11 visible mature gully conifers, measured on the 1254 px source and scaled by 2560/1254; median source width 44 px.

waterMask.encoding: opaque white water pixels on fully transparent non-water pixels; binary alpha
waterMask.componentNote: One continuous channel plus small source-painted detached ripple, wash, and spray flecks retained to cover the full painted water extent.

refusalReasons: The selected source paints the beck at x=317.5 px / 25.319% of the north edge; the required handover is x=376.2 px / 30%. The centerline is 58.7 px, about 4.57 m, too far west.

Two whole-canvas ImageGen candidates were used. Candidate 1 met the handover more closely but was rejected for regular palisade-like columns and excessive small conifers. A third candidate would violate the two-candidate spend cap, and patching or shifting the source would violate the raw-generation rule.
openRisks: Long terrace faces still contain visible vertical joint rhythms; whether they remain sufficiently weathered and irregular is a visual judgment for the owner.
The water mask was checked by full-canvas overlay and source-scale fringe proxies, but no shipped-canvas pipeline gate was run in this quarantine-only task.
The crown measurement is a manual outer-foliage census; the automated dark-core component check found a conservative 70.431 px / 3.381 m median from two isolated cores.
